item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting with no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Let the composition feel like a mind holding several currents at once: a dense, restless center of layered cobalt, ultramarine, and deep plum, crossed by sudden strokes of hot vermilion and pale gold; translucent veils drift outward into broad fields of warm gray and soft ivory, with a few quiet areas of near-black. Use varied brushwork—scraped passages, dry-brush grain, pooled pigment, fine flicks, and broad, sweeping gestures—to create shifts between pressure and release. Build visual rhythm through repeated strokes that almost align, then break apart; let color accumulate in some areas and thin to open space in others. Keep the balance unsettled but coherent, with strong contrast and tactile texture. Entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
